content: उपाङ्गः A mark of sandal on the forehead. .{@-गम्@} .²1 A subdivision, a sub-head. <ls>Mb. 1. 100. 38</ls> .²2 Any minor limb or member (of anything); वर्गाः … साङ्गोपाङ्गैरिहोदिताः <ls>Ak.</ls> .²3 A supplement of a supplement. .²4 A supplementary work (of inferior value). .²5 A secondary portion of science; a class of writings supplementary to the Vedāngas; (these are four:-- पुराणन्यायमीमांसाधर्मशास्त्राणि). .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of the class of sacred writings of the Jainas.
